editable_paint_definition.bow: Own warm wood longitudinal gradient/ridge and grip bindings; Veteran pale recurve edge painted into tapered hooked surface, not added cap
editable_paint_definition.calf: Own boot upper 68 percent, continuous long axis, painted light not re-lit
editable_paint_definition.feather: Own painted feather sample with deliberate central rachis, alternating diagonal gold/dark barbs and darker outside edge; opaque material on actual three-vane mesh
editable_paint_definition.foot: Own boot lower 38 percent; cuff-to-vamp longitudinal mapping, no repeated calf highlight
editable_paint_definition.shoulder: Separate near/far own projected padded islands, shared pauldron/arm UV; soft two-sided shoulder boundary bridge sampled from own paint
editable_paint_definition.thigh: Own upper-leg paint; upper hem shadow feathered into top 16 percent of longitudinal island

note: Opaque RGB on real surfaces. Editable final material inputs; do not use texture alpha to change body or feet.
